title.zh: L22.2a 文献库全文检索 + 风工程数据抽取
title.en: L22.2a Full-text search of the literature library + wind-engineering data extraction

conclusion.zh: 10-14 已转正为平台工具 pages：验收五组全过线，二期非首页事实题 22/27 到页；三期盲测 10-14：到页 21/30（中文 9/10、中译英 8/10、书 4/7、扫描书 0/3），书籍偏弱经平台 0062 改进后 round3 书籍到页 4/10→7/10（达标）、round4 8/12 不变；台式机 I 盘已连通并清点：净新增约 1.25 万 PDF/42 万页，第一阶段已抽 28.9 万页有文字页（工作站 1.8 GB）；台式机语料 0069 已上线（10-16），台式机来源盲测到页 11/30（两库 24/30），改进线索已交平台；10-15 全部推进：剩余 10.5 万页 OCR 10-16 02:38 完成（105,336 页，已交 0069）、三库元数据与作品去重、djvu/pdg 书 31,365 页已交平台（472 页超星格式未解）、litwiki/knowledge 试用已回；入库等 0051 与 C 盘处理。10-13 结论：只做检索。两库 4,691 PDF/12.9 万页本地按页索引；非首页事实题前 5 精确到页约一半（英文 8/14、中文原文 5/5、中文问英文译问题后 3/5、书 4/6）， 论文级 1/27；平台已接入（三期，一期本周内），原型冻结作对照；` pages` 一期已上线（10-13 22:40 实测）；扫描件 OCR 79 份/5,422 页已交二期。廓线抽取搁置（单页文本 6/78 错、27/78 需限定，图页常定位错）；0 CU；另一台电脑上的书待 Liang Hu 给信息
conclusion.en: 10-14 Promoted to the platform tool pages: all five acceptance groups passed, and Phase 2 non-first-page fact questions reached the target page on 22/27; Phase 3 blind test on 10-14: 21/30 reached the page (Chinese 9/10, Chinese-to-English 8/10, books 4/7, scanned books 0/3); books were weak, and after platform improvement 0062, round3 book page hits rose from 4/10 to 7/10 (meeting the target) while round4 remained 8/12; the desktop I drive is connected and inventoried: net new ~12.5k PDFs / 420k pages, with Phase 1 extracting 289k text-layer pages (1.8 GB on the workstation); desktop corpus 0069 went live (10-16), hitting the target page on 11/30 in the desktop-source blind test (vs. 24/30 for the two libraries), with improvement leads handed to the platform; 10-15 all tracks pushed forward: OCR of the remaining 105k pages completed at 10-16 02:38 (105,336 pages, handed to 0069), three-library metadata and work-level deduplication, 31,365 pages of djvu/pdg books handed to the platform (472 Chaoxing-format pages unresolved), and litwiki/knowledge trial results returned; ingestion awaits 0051 and C drive cleanup. 10-13 conclusion: retrieval only. Two libraries with 4,691 PDFs / 129k pages indexed locally by page; for non-first-page fact questions, top-5 results hit the exact page about half the time (English 8/14, Chinese originals 5/5, Chinese queries on English papers 3/5 after query translation, books 4/6), paper-level 1/27; platform integration underway (three phases, Phase 1 within the week), prototype frozen as baseline; `pages` Phase 1 is live (tested 10-13 22:40); OCR of 79 scanned documents / 5,422 pages handed to Phase 2. Profile extraction is Shelved (single-page text had 6/78 errors and 27/78 requiring qualification, with figure pages often mislocated); 0 CU; books on the other computer await information from Liang Hu

title.zh: L22.3 自建/本地模型对我们研究的用途
title.en: L22.3 Uses of self-built / local models for our research

conclusion.zh: 不做自己的语言大模型（继续预训练/全量微调），LoRA 暂不做。评测 200 题摘要初筛：本地 Qwen3-32B 82.0%、Claude Sonnet 80.5%、Gemini 3.8 Flash 85.5%（置信区间重叠）；50 题 PDF 单值抽取：本地 92%、前沿 96%。建议成批筛选/抽取交 Gemini 3.8 Flash 批量通道或 Colab 本地 Qwen3-32B，Claude 只做复核；约 6.8 CU。物理场代理部分另留档搁置
conclusion.en: Do not build our own large language model (continued pre-training / full fine-tuning); LoRA not for now. Evaluation on 200 abstract-screening questions: local Qwen3-32B 82.0%, Claude Sonnet 80.5%, Gemini 3.8 Flash 85.5% (confidence intervals overlap); 50 single-value PDF extraction questions: local 92%, frontier 96%. Recommendation: send batch screening/extraction to the Gemini 3.8 Flash batch channel or local Qwen3-32B on Colab, with Claude used only for re-checking; about 6.8 CU. The physical-field surrogate part is archived separately and shelved
